cleavage_agent: samples containing 10 mg of protein per tissue were digested with trypsin
enrichment_method: prior to phosphopeptide enrichment via immobilized metal affinity chromatography
fractionation_method: the resulting peptides fractionated via strong cation exchange chromatography
labeling: inferred: Our data suggest that the ‘typical’ phosphoprotein is widely expressed, yet displays variable, often tissue-specific phosphorylation that tunes protein activity to the specific needs of each tissue.
mass_analyzer: inferred: Phosphopeptides were analyzed in duplicate via LC-MS/MS on an LTQ-Orbitrap mass spectrometer.

instrument.evidence: Phosphopeptides were analyzed in duplicate via LC-MS/MS on an LTQ-Orbitrap mass spectrometer.

ptm.evidence: We identified 12,039 proteins, including 6296 phosphoproteins harboring nearly 36,000 phosphorylation sites.
